english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a brief flash or gleam of light.

exampleSentences.english: The ring can glint briefly in the sunlight.
exampleSentences.traditional: 戒指喺陽光下閃咗一下。

english.note: For a light that blinks or flashes on and off, 閃 is the all-purpose choice.

exampleSentences.english: I see the lamp flash on and off, making my eyes go blurry.
exampleSentences.traditional: 盞燈閃吓閃吓，搞到我眼都花。
exampleSentences.jyutping: zaan2 dang1 sim2 haa5 sim2 haa5 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 ngaan5 dou1 faa1
